conclusion: After removing the live-rejected max_tool_calls field, the synchronous Responses request did not return before the 60 second application timeout. For a hackathon demo path, extending synchronous latency beyond one minute is pruned rather than promoted.
next_candidate: Return to the already runtime-observed Chat Completions explicit-function transport, but replace the verbose multi-action function contract with a compact semantic plan envelope. The adapter will deterministically derive proposal IDs, intents, preconditions, estimated effects and non-executable patch projection metadata; Nemotron still proposes dependencies, state transitions and evidence lineage. Phoenix Plan Gate remains unchanged.
